description: Remove one scheduled workout from the Garmin calendar; the workout itself and its other dates are kept. scheduleId is the calendar entry's ID, not the workout's: workoutScheduleId from schedule-workout or create-structured-workout, or scheduleId from show-training-week. To move a workout to another day, unschedule it, then schedule-workout on the new date.
name: unschedule-workout
title: Unschedule Workout
